entries.05ce61d4d2876233: This is a business that sells optical components, light source devices and optical fibers for installation in inspection equipment for semiconductors, liquid crystals and solar cells. Illumination optical fibers are supplied as components for visual inspection equipment that photographs defects in products during manufacturing and removes defective items. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 is ¥1,393 million.

entries.159807705aa56296: This is a business in which the domestic subsidiary Sakusaku Co., Ltd. operates “Sakusaku EC,” an online store selling cutting tools and others via the internet. It sells high-quality, low-priced products, including original items, and also offers a custom-order service for end mills. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 is ¥133 million.
entries.1684696ac51239e7: This is a business that mainly sells wear-resistant tools, such as can-making tools, to domestic can manufacturers. Wear-resistant tools are custom products used to shape materials into tool forms through plastic working, and are required to withstand heat, pressure and friction. It also sells crushing blades for the paper and environmental recycling industries, molds and consumable parts for the battery industry, and blade dies for bag-making machine manufacturers. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 is ¥2,259 million.

entries.759099fbb11518c3: This is a business in which the company and its domestic subsidiaries Ōnishi Kikō Co., Ltd. and Tōshin Shōkai Co., Ltd. sell carbide cutting tools and special steel cutting tools to metal processing companies, such as those making automotive engine parts. It also sells holding tools, measuring instruments, machine tools and others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥17,461 million, making it the largest business. It has a two-division structure: a direct sales division that sells face-to-face to large companies, and a wholesale division that delivers to small and medium-sized metal processing companies through its dealer network.
